captions.title: Ask in the agent panel
captions.body: One sentence to Antigravity's agent, about a 44,714-row file in the project.

captions.title: The map opens in the chat
captions.body: TinyPivot sums 2026 MRR by region on your machine and draws it right in the agent panel, in its 1-Bit theme.

captions.title: Answered from every row
captions.body: North America leads at $17.12M, 35.5% of $48.19M, across all 22,730 orders of 2026.

transcript: map 2026 MRR by region from acme-orders.csv, then tell me which region leads. North America leads 2026 MRR at $17.12M (35.5% of the $48.19M total), ahead of EMEA by $2.16M.
